    //==
    // # IStack
    //
    // LIFO helpers. Push / Pop return new stacks.

    // Replace the top element: pop the current top, then push the new item.
    // Precondition: the stack is not empty.
    ReplaceTop(self: IStack<$T>, item: $T): IStack<$T>
        => self.Pop.Push(item);
